title: Stop Getting Robbed: A Pirate's Guide to Ransomware (And Why Your Company's Next
fullText: Don't get robbed by my lousy successors. Listen to a real pirate. 26% of your competitors got hit last year. Your average ransom, $120,000. And 75% of you can't operate during an attack. The question isn't if, it's when. Are you ready? I spent my life stealing from merchant ships. At least I was honest about it. These hackers, they call themselves advanced threat actors. They send fishing emails and call it social engineering. They're cowards, amateurs, my bad successors. That's why we built Cyber Siege. Six chapters, six podcasts, 170 minutes, not buzzwords, not frameworks, a real playbook, why you're a target, how attacks work, how to defend, what to do in 72 hours, what insurance actually covers, how to win contracts by passing audits. Written for businesses without a dedicated IT team. Written by people who've managed hundreds of crises. Cost of one ransomware attack 120,000. Cost of cyber siege $47. $2554 to one return. You only need to avoid 04% of a single attack to break even. We doubt the guide can't do that for you. this day. First 100 buyers full access immediate. After that, pricing changes. Go to the-confidential.com. Stop getting robbed by my bad successors.
